diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a moderate downward trend (a net fall of ~53% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.115), which favours a robust combination.

Testing a robust weighted scheme on a smaller, more diverse pool (pool4) to see if focusing on the strongest, least correlated models improves over median/trimmed mean.
